Junior Penetration Tester at Tatweer MEA, running the VAPT program as the sole in-house pentester. Focused on offensive security and AI security: web/network pentesting, LLM/agent exploitation, and building AI tooling for real testing workflows. My work sits at the intersection of AI agent orchestration (OpenRouter, local models, Hugging Face) and offensive security.
I welcome opportunities to connect and collaborate on innovative security challenges.
